categories.name: Admission to Normal Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an inpatient normal care ward (Task 15). Advances patient care toward hospital disposition while minimizing intensive care burdens.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared OR alternative for normal care admission (Task 15), observed across various routine and extended ward stays in the sample.

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care unit (Task 16). Associated with higher acuity treatment but carries a negative contribution to minimizing time-to-treatment softgoals due to resource constraints.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared OR alternative for intensive care admission (Task 16), which is mutually exclusive with normal care at the point of decision per the goal model's XOR/OR structure.
